chunks: And Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"Washing the head with sidr brings sustenance abundantly."

key_terms.بِالسِّدْرِ: with sidr; with lote tree leaves used for washing

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام say about washing the head with sidr and sustenance?
ai.summary: Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that washing the head with sidr is a means of attracting sustenance. The report reflects a teaching on cleanliness and a beneficial practice associated with increased provision.
